description: Election Commission - Notice under Section 66B (1)(a) Appointed Gama Ethige Ariyadasa as a Chairman of the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with filling a vacancy in the office of Chairman of the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes at the local government level, including the nomination and declaration of a new chairman following a resignation, which falls under election-related matters.
